⚡️ Army chief praises Basij contributions to Iran’s security, public service

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army Chief Major General Amir Hatami praises the Basij Organization for its role in critical moments, saying the volunteer force has demonstrated commitment through defense, relief work, and social services.

In a message marking Basij Week, Hatami described the organization as a lasting strategic initiative of the late Imam Khomeini and a force rooted in public faith and resolve to safeguard Iran’s independence, security, and dignity.
​
He said the Basij had played an effective role in the Sacred Defense during the war imposed by the Iraqi Ba’ath regime, countering threats, helping disadvantaged communities, reconstruction, emergency response, scientific and cultural activities, and protecting public security.
​
Hatami said this record showed that the Basij was more than an organization; it represented a culture of faith, people-oriented values, responsibility, and self-sacrifice.
​
This year’s Basij Week slogan, “Basij: Devoted to the People, Hope for the Underprivileged,” reflected its close ties with the public, he said. The force had stood alongside people during difficult circumstances, including natural disasters and service campaigns. Public trust, he added, was its greatest source of strength.
​
Referring to the recent war, Hatami said Basij members had stood alongside other Armed Forces and the public in confronting complex threats to Iran’s independence, security, and territorial integrity. Their presence, he said, demonstrated the force’s capacity and public readiness to defend the country.
​
Hatami concluded by honoring Basij members killed in service and congratulating its members, veterans, families of martyrs, and the Iranian people on Basij Week, and praised their continued service to Iran.
